column1: # conf/public-gate.tsv — 公开前必须先完成的安全项（issue #3574, EPIC #3569 C4）
# The ONE copy of the gate. Read by bin/fleet-gate-check.sh (the doctor's `gate`
# rows, a machine's half sent to the hub on its heartbeat) and by the hub's
# /v1/fleet/gate (packed into the client manifest, so the hub reads these bytes).
# The design is EPIC #3500 v3 「安全模型 / 凭据生命周期」 — this table only names
# which items stand between us and going public, and how each is judged.
# A #3500 member that finishes its item makes ITS judge go green (the function
# named in `judge`) — it never edits a row. Columns, TAB-separated:
#   n       the item's number (stable, never reused)
#   id      its key (the judge is gate_<id with - as _> in fleet-gate-check.sh,
#           or gateJudge["<id>"] in the hub's fleet_gate.go)
#   where   node — each machine judges it from what it runs (ps, users, groups)
#           hub  — the hub judges it from its own settings and every login's beat
#   before  推广 = must be green before public promotion; 客户 = before the
#           first hosted customer (推广,客户 = both)
#   source  the #3500 member that delivers it
#   title   the item, as the person reads it
#   judge   what makes it PASS (for people; the code is the judge function)

column6: 发布签名私钥只在发布列车里，有离线根钥匙能作废
column7: 入口的环境与挂载里没有发布签名私钥（CCQUOTA_FLEET_RELEASE_KEY、/etc/ccquota-release）

column6: root 只剩最小核心，只认写死的动作表

column6: 节点守护不是 root；个人账号里不跑整机服务
column7: 整机服务（node supervisor · ccquota agent --machine · memguard · credsep machine）只以 _fleetnode/fleetnode 跑

column6: 开号删号的管理员程序搬出个人账号，只认入口签过的单
column7: 没有一个带管理员权限（admin/sudo/wheel）的个人账号在跑 ccquota agent；管理员程序只以 _fleetadmin/fleetadmin 跑

column6: 云上每个服务只有它要的权限
column7: 入口在集群里跑，且它的 pod 没挂服务账号令牌（automountServiceAccountToken: false）

column6: 会话读得到的凭据 ≤ 12 小时（通行证 4 小时），所有托管登录做凭据隔离
